title: Home Mortgage Loans Credit Policy Matrix: Loan Amount, Loan-to-Value, Credit Score and Debt-to-Income Limits
content:
Credit Policy publishes, for each Home Mortgage Loans program, the smallest and largest loan amount the program is written for, the largest loan amount expressed as a percent of the lower of the appraised value and the purchase price, the lowest representative credit score underwriting accepts, and the highest debt-to-income ratio underwriting accepts.

## Matrix

| Program | Smallest loan amount | Largest loan amount | Largest loan-to-value | Lowest credit score | Highest debt-to-income |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| FHA 30-Year Fixed Mortgage | $50000.00 | $524225.00 | 96.5 percent | 580 | 57 percent |
| VA 30-Year Fixed Mortgage | $50000.00 | $1500000.00 | 100 percent | 580 | 60 percent |
| Conventional 30-Year Fixed Mortgage | $50000.00 | $832750.00 | 97 percent | 620 | 50 percent |
| Conventional 15-Year Fixed Mortgage | $50000.00 | $832750.00 | 97 percent | 620 | 50 percent |
| 7/6 SOFR Adjustable-Rate Mortgage | $100000.00 | $1500000.00 | 95 percent | 660 | 45 percent |
| Jumbo 30-Year Fixed Mortgage | $832751.00 | $3000000.00 | 80 percent | 700 | 43 percent |

The loan-to-value column is the largest loan amount the program allows as a percent of the lower of the appraised value and the purchase price. The credit score column is the lowest representative score accepted, and the debt-to-income column the highest ratio accepted.

## Where the amount bands meet

The amount bands of the two Conventional programs and of the Jumbo 30-Year Fixed Mortgage are adjacent and do not overlap. A loan of $832750.00 falls at the top of the Conventional band and one dollar below the smallest Jumbo amount; a loan of $832751.00 is the smallest the Jumbo program is written for.

## Points of judgement

The three largest ceilings in the matrix belong to the VA 30-Year Fixed Mortgage and the 7/6 SOFR Adjustable-Rate Mortgage, each written to $1500000.00, and to the Jumbo 30-Year Fixed Mortgage, written to $3000000.00.

The lowest score the matrix accepts anywhere is 580, carried by the two agency programs; the strictest score and ratio of the six are the Jumbo program's 700 and 43 percent.
